Subject: Next steps — procurement path & timeline for Redwood Inference pilot

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the demo and the honest discussion about timelines and compliance needs. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so procurement has a single place to work from: 

Summary of ask from Acme Health
- Pilot: ~3 GPU nodes for 6 weeks to validate latency and cost at expected payloads
- Data handling: no PHI to be logged; customer-managed KMS option desired
- Commercial: procurement prefers a PO-based flow; payment card only acceptable for small POCs

Proposed commercial path (options)
1) Standard PO path (recommended by your procurement): Redwood SOW + vendor packet -> Legal review -> Security questionnaire -> Finance issues PO -> Start.
2) Marketplace path (faster procurement for some customers): Acme buys via Azure/AWS marketplace listing. Procurement will confirm if this is acceptable; often simplifies invoicing but can require different contract terms.
3) Card/transactional: acceptable only for trials < $5k per month.

Proposed milestone timeline (rough)
- Week 0 (this week): I upload SOW + procurement packet to your procurement mailbox (attached). Please confirm receipt.
- Week 1: Legal and security receive documents; our security engineer available for a 45-min walkthrough.
- Weeks 2–3: Security questionnaire + any clarifying items returned to us.
- Week 3–4: Procurement/finance finalizes PO terms.
- Week 4–6: PO issued, onboarding scheduled.

Ask from you
- Can you confirm the preferred commercial path (PO vs marketplace vs card)?
- Who will own the security questionnaire internally (name/email)?
- Target PO approval date (tentative) — does 2026-03-15 look realistic?

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_template.pdf, MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan with suggested owner assignments)

I can update the MAP to reflect dates you provide and can get legal/finance intro if you'd like.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement/legal perspective: 

1) Preferred commercial path: PO is preferred. Marketplace could be an option but procurement will need to review the marketplace terms — historically we have to route marketplace purchases through a different approval flow which can add time.

2) Security questionnaire: Jordan Hill (Security Ops) will own the questionnaire and coordinate with our InfoSec reviewers. Jordan copied.

3) Timeline: Legal tends to take 5–7 business days for a standard SOW review; security questionnaire turnaround depends on complexity but plan for 7–10 business days. Finance/PO once terms are agreed usually takes 3–5 business days to issue a PO. If we start this week, your Week 4–6 PO issuance estimate is reasonable.

Notes/questions:
- Please attach SOC2 and any redlineable SOW. Procurement will want license/usage caps clearly stated.
- Pricing: can you confirm list vs pilot pricing? We typically require a line-item pricing table in the SOW.

Ill assign Jordan to coordinate security kickoff and will have procurement monitor the MAP you attached.

Thanks,
Sarah Bennett
Director, Clinical Analytics | Acme Health
